# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first interactive novel / relationship meter choice game.
- objective: Choose dialogue replies that raise a bounded trust/sync meter from 50 toward 100 before it collapses to 0.
- input model: Tap/click start, sound toggle, restart, and one of several large dialogue choice buttons.
- core loop: Screen transition to chat, delayed NPC message, render choices, player taps a choice, meter changes, visual/audio feedback fires, next node loads, and terminal win/loss screen appears.
- fail/friction state: Negative choices lower the meter, trigger shake/broken-heart feedback, and reaching 0 or an invalid terminal node closes the channel.

## Protected mechanics
- Start screen, game screen, and end screen state flow are preserved.
- Bounded relationship meter starts at 50, clamps 0-100, wins at 100/WIN, and loses at 0 or unresolved node.
- Dialogue node graph, delayed typing cadence, choice rendering, per-choice score deltas, next-node routing, feedback particles, shake, audio unlock, and restart semantics remain mechanically equivalent.
- Mobile tap/click buttons remain native and large enough for portrait play.

## Remixed target
Moonlit Pact: Rain at Forks-ish High reframes the same branching relationship-meter chat as a satirical forbidden romance fantasy. The player exchanges melodramatic texts with E.L.I.A.S., an immortal hallway lurker, while a rain-soaked forest, vampire/wolf love-triangle motifs, Yearning Meter HUD, heart/black-heart feedback, and mobile portrait UI express immortal longing without changing the underlying choice-and-meter mechanics.
